description: The secret masker of the approval card and the request (maskSecrets in lib/permissions.mjs): each rule of TOKEN_PATTERNS, the name of a secret (prefix, endings, quotes), what a bare value may be, the registered secrets, and (after the audit of PR #103) the PGP key, the key in one line, the exemptions (types, reads of the environment, placeholders, fetch options), the flags of a command and XML, judged by tests/verify-mask-secrets.mjs (the 49 spellings and the 47 lines of the audit, the shapes, one line for every word of a list, the edges, and the layouts for time). Second round of PR #103: the keys are hidden by hideKeyBlocks in one pass (and before the other rules), -u/--user/--proxy-user only after curl (over the continuation of a line), -p of mysql, sshpass and docker login by case. Third round of PR #103: what is hidden between two frames is what looks like a key (hideKeyText, looksLikeKey), and -u/--user/--proxy-user are masked in every command but for a numeric pair and the flags of a container client (afterContainerClient). Round 4 of PR #103: the flags of the user are judged on the command that holds the flag (commandStart, holdsNetworkClient, startsWithContainerClient), and what is hidden in a body is every run of 16 characters or more of base64 (KEY_RUN).

patches.old: (all, head, quote, user, password, at, source) => (readableUserFlag(source, at, user, password) ? all : `${head}[REDACTED]${quote}`)],
patches.new: (all, head, quote, user, password, at, source) => (readableUserFlag(source, 0, user, password) ? all : `${head}[REDACTED]${quote}`)],

mutations.name: MS-run-length-short
mutations.what: a run of 15 characters is a key (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-length-long
mutations.what: a run of 16 characters is not a key (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-class-upper
mutations.what: a capital is not a character of a run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-class-lower
mutations.what: a small letter is not a character of a run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-class-digit
mutations.what: a digit is not a character of a run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-class-plus
mutations.what: a plus is not a character of a run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-class-slash
mutations.what: a slash is not a character of a run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-class-underscore
mutations.what: an underscore is not a character of a run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-class-hyphen
mutations.what: a hyphen is not a character of a run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-padding-none
mutations.what: the = after a run stays (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-padding-one
mutations.what: only one = goes with the run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-padding-three
mutations.what: three = go with the run (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-global
mutations.what: only the first run of a row is hidden (the masker)

mutations.name: MS-run-body-row
mutations.what: a row of a body that is not one token keeps its runs of base64

mutations.name: MS-run-part
mutations.what: a part of a row that is not nothing but base64 keeps its runs of base64

mutations.name: MS-run-edges
mutations.what: the text on the line of a frame (the edges of a block, a key in one line) is not hidden

mutations.name: MS-run-middle
mutations.what: the lines between the frames are not hidden

mutations.name: MS-whole-row
mutations.what: a row of a body that is one short token (the last line of a key) is not hidden whole

mutations.name: MS-whole-part
mutations.what: a part of a row that is nothing but base64 is hidden run by run, not whole
